This file guides Claude Code for this repository.

**CRITICAL**: This project uses **UV** for all Python operations. Never use `python -m`, `pip install`, or `python script.py` directly.

Commands:
```bash
uv run pytest
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/
uv pip install package
uv run python script.py
make dev
make verify
make test
uv run pytest tests/pm_agent/ -v
uv run pytest tests/test_file.py -v
uv run pytest -m confidence_check
uv run pytest --cov=superclaude
make lint
make format
make doctor
make build-plugin
make sync-plugin-repo
make clean
pipx install superclaude
git clone https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework.git
cd SuperClaude_Framework
```

**⚠️ IMPORTANT**: The `.claude-plugin/` directory and TypeScript plugin system described in older docs **DO NOT EXIST** in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0 (see [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419)).
**⚠️ NOT IMPLEMENTED**: The TypeScript plugin system described below does not exist in v4.1.9. This is planned for v5.0. See [issue #419](https://github.com/SuperClaude-Org/SuperClaude_Framework/issues/419) and `docs/plugin-reorg.md`.

Current v4.1.9: Python package, slash commands in `~/.claude/commands/`, installed via `pipx install superclaude && superclaude install`; commands include `/pm`, `/research`, `/index-repo`. Package uses hatchling; CLI is `superclaude`; pytest plugin auto-loads as `superclaude`, registered via `pyproject.toml`.

Key paths: `src/superclaude/` (`pytest_plugin.py`, `pm_agent/`, `execution/`, `cli/`), `tests/`, `scripts/`, `PLANNING.md`, `TASK.md`, `KNOWLEDGE.md`, `docs/user-guide/`, `docs/developer-guide/`, `docs/reference/`.

Never guess - verify with official docs (Context7 MCP, WebFetch, WebSearch) before implementation. Always prefer MCP tools over speculation for documentation/research. Check confidence BEFORE starting: ≥90% proceed, 70-89% present alternatives, <70% ask questions.

Use **Wave → Checkpoint → Wave** pattern (3.5x faster): `[Read files in parallel]` → Analyze → `[Edit files in parallel]`. Use ConfidenceChecker, SelfCheckProtocol, and ReflexionPattern; verify implementation with tests/docs, with no speculation. Budgets: simple 200, medium 1,000, complex 2,500 tokens.

**CRITICAL**: When running multiple Claude Code sessions in parallel, use `git worktree` to avoid conflicts.
```bash
cd ~/github/SuperClaude_Framework
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration integration
git worktree add ../SuperClaude_Framework-feature feature/pm-agent
git worktree remove ../SuperClaude_Framework-integration
```
Branch flow: `master` ← `integration` ← `feature/*`, `fix/*`, `docs/*`. Develop with tests, use conventional commits, merge integration then master.
